name: hw-write-title
title: Handwritten Write-On Title
description: True glyph write-on: filled Caveat letterforms revealed by baked per-glyph centerline strokes traced in real stroke order with a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease (fast on straights, slow into curves, inter-stroke pen lifts); optional squiggle underline; boils

controls.name: scheme
controls.drives: which authored token set inks the letterforms (chalk-white over footage / marker-ink on boards)

controls.name: animation
controls.drives: entrance (the write-on itself; false = hard-on) and exit fade — durations derived, never exposed

controls.name: boil
controls.drives: boil amp/rot as authored pairs over the family-locked frameDrop 3; seed locked

controls.name: writeOn
controls.drives: reveal mechanic: pen-traced stroke order with velocity physics / per-glyph staggered fade / hard-on — trace duration derived from stroke count

controls.name: underline
controls.drives: seeded accent squiggle underline drawn after the write lands
